[
  {
    "title": "TCS AGENTIC - Positive Testing: Successful LTE Attach and Detach of Multiple UEs under Excellent Radio Conditions",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network configured as a single isolated LTE cell with no inter-cell interference",
      "At least two stationary UEs placed in cell center with LTE RSRP within excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6",
      "All other cells powered off",
      "Test configuration parameters recorded"
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Start call flow and signalling message logging",
      "Power ON all UEs to initiate LTE Attach procedure",
      "Wait for successful attach confirmation for all UEs by validating attach request and attach complete messages",
      "Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete for each UE",
      "Power OFF all UEs to initiate LTE Detach procedure",
      "Wait for successful detach confirmation by validating detach request and detach accept messages for all UEs",
      "Stop and save test logs",
      "Repeat steps 2 to 7 for a total of 10 iterations"
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs successfully attach and detach 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate",
      "Attach latency metrics (minimum, average, maximum) recorded for each UE",
      "No connectivity issues or message failures observed",
      "Attach and detach procedures conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1 respectively"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Log analysis for attach and detach message flows",
      "UE log verification for correct cell attachment (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)",
      "Measurement of LTE RSRP to confirm excellent radio conditions"
    ]
  },

    "title": "TCS AGENTIC - Positive Testing: Successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach of Multiple UEs with Secondary Node Addition and Release",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network configured as a single isolated 5G NSA cell with no inter-cell interference",
      "At least two stationary UEs placed in cell center with 5G SS-RSRP within excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6",
      "All other cells powered off",
      "Test configuration parameters recorded"
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Start call flow and signalling message logging",
      "Power ON all UEs to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure including EN-DC Secondary Node Addition as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1",
      "Wait for successful attach and secondary node addition confirmation for all UEs by validating attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages",
      "Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete for each UE",
      "Power OFF all UEs to initiate detach procedure including LTE detach and 5G secondary node release as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 and TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1",
      "Wait for successful detach confirmation for all UEs by validating detach request, detach accept, and secondary node release messages",
      "Stop and save test logs",
      "Repeat steps 2 to 7 for a total of 10 iterations"
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs successfully complete attach with secondary node addition and detach with secondary node release 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate",
      "Attach latency metrics (minimum, average, maximum) recorded for each UE",
      "No connectivity issues or message failures observed",
      "Signalling connection release validated via UE context release and RRC connection release messages",
      "Secondary Node Release procedure executed correctly per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Log analysis for attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release message flows",
      "UE log verification for correct cell attachment (PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)",
      "Measurement of 5G SS-RSRP to confirm excellent radio conditions"
    ]
  },
